items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: we had a guitar player by the name of Buford Turner

ctx.x: Oh, no, not Ray. I may think of it. Anyway, we had a guitar player by the name of Buford Turner, and it was a cooperative band, incidentally. So like I wasn't exactly responsible for what happened, you know. I was the guy up in front of it, but I mean we'd have our meetings, and when

they'd say don't play this and don't play that and the band would say no, we've got to play what we're going to play, and I'd say okay. You know. But that was the end of the big business cooperative band.
